caption: In Kyiv's Bucha district, two people walk through smoky rubble after a Russian strike.

Devighat, Nepal Women view the widened channel of the Trishuli River after flash floods in Devighat. Rescuers have built temporary bridges to reach remote areas and dug through the ruins of hydropower projects in the Himalayas to rescue hundreds of trapped workers, as the death toll passed 1,000 nearly ⁠a week after devastating ​floods left a trail of destruction across the country’s towns and valleys.

Rasuwa, Nepal Members of a search and rescue team at the Trishuli-3A hydropower project in Rasuwa rescue a man. Two people were pulled out alive from the hydropower tunnel nine days after deadly flash floods buried the project in deep mud and left them trapped.

Kathmandu, Nepal Relatives mourn during the symbolic cremation of four members of the Magar family who remain missing after the flash floods , at Pashupatinath Temple in Kathmandu. The bodies of some of those killed in the Nepal-Tibet flood disaster may never be found, and some of those who are found may never be identified, a renowned forensic scientist, Prof Richard Bassed, said this week.

Devighat, Nepal Rescue workers inspect damaged structures after the recent flash flooding along the Trishuli River in Devighat. The disaster was triggered by a glacier collapse that sent a deluge of ice, rock and mud through Nepal’s border region with China.

Galchi, Nepal A mark shows the mud level on a wall in a classroom at Bageshwori secondary school after flash floods in Galchi. The Himalayas – spanning Nepal, India, China, Bhutan and Pakistan – are warming twice as fast as the global average, putting the region at increased risk of avalanches , landslides and floods.
Kyiv, Ukraine Children play with bubbles during traditional back-to-school celebrations in Kyiv.

Kyiv, Ukraine People visit a McDonald’s restaurant that was the first to open in Ukraine, in an area hit by ​​numerous Russian missile attacks. Volodymyr Zelenskyy this week declared that Russia’s airspace was becoming unsafe for commercial airlines, as Vladimir Putin promised to increase strikes against Ukraine’s energy facilities in the run-up to winter.
Al-Mansouri, Lebanon Smoke billows from houses hit during Israeli attacks in the town of al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon.

Sinjil, West Bank A Palestinian man scans a valley with a flashlight during a volunteer nightwatch to help prevent Israeli settler attacks in the town of Sinjil. Israelis shot dead two teenagers in the Palestinian village of al-Mughayyir and Israeli troops razed the village of Khirbet al-Taban, outside Hebron, in the latest attacks across the occupied West Bank.

Gaza Palestinian children watch a film screening organised by the Little Wings Cinema initiative in Gaza. Israel’s far-right national security minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, set out a plan this week for the illegal forced expulsion of all Palestinians from the Gaza Strip, with the intention of sending them abroad. Earlier this year, an independent UN inquiry found that Israel continued to commit genocide by deliberately targeting Palestinian children in Gaza.
Big Sur, California Sage Harvey throws a rope off the roof of his house as the Plaskett Fire approaches.

Pattaya, Thailand A crew member walks on the flight deck of the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln as it heads towards Laem Chabang port. The aircraft carrier has been plagued by reports of deteriorating living conditions and poor mental health onboard , including attempted suicides, making headlines around the world and provoking criticism of Donald Trump’s war against Iran.

Menab, Iran A child receives treatment at a hospital in Menab after being wounded, according to Tasnim news agency, in a strike on a home where a wedding was being held in the city of Kuhestak. Iran accused the US of a war crime after a missile blast killed at least four people and injured 68 who were attending the wedding.
Port-au-Prince, Haiti A woman, overwhelmed with grief, is carried out of a funeral service for more than 20 people killed by armed gangs last week in Kenscoff, a neighbourhood near Port-au-Prince.

Washington DC, US A demonstrator dressed as a blood-covered Lady Justice attends a Defend the Vote rally at the Lincoln Memorial. A new system to screen millions of mail-in ballots for this November’s US midterm elections was thrown together so hastily, and tested so little, that a single scanning glitch could lead to entire batches of ballots being turned away, a whistleblower has told Congress.
London, England Costumed participants in the Notting Hill carnival travel on the tube.
Basra, Iraq A man dives into the Shatt al-Arab River amid soaring temperatures in Basra.

Lake Baringo, Kenya A person holds a Nile crocodile at Lake Baringo, where Kenya Wildlife Service is facilitating the capture and translocation of the animals to reduce cases of human-wildlife conflict near Marigat.

International Space Station The European Space Agency astronaut Sophie Adenot works during a spacewalk outside the ISS. Adenot and the Nasa astronaut Anil Menon completed the installation and activation of a spare space-to-ground antenna.
One of two workers is carried to safety after being pulled alive from a tunnel at the Trishuli-3A hydropower project nine days after deadly flash floods.
Dharamshala, India The Tibetan spiritual leader the Dalai Lama greets devotees from inside his car.
Lalitpur, Nepal Devotees gather at the historic Krishna Mandir in Patan Durbar Square to celebrate Krishna Janmashtami, marking the birth of Lord Krishna.
Brisbane, Australia A Royal Australian Air Force F/A-18F Super Hornet flies past people standing on the Story Bridge during a practice run for Riverfire during the 2026 Brisbane festival.
Istanbul, Turkey The Russian-flagged cargo ship Omskiy-107, which has run aground near Alacalı Beach. The vessel was damaged by a Ukranian drone and was attacked before drifting across the Black Sea.
Kangerlussuaq, Greenland A Danish conscript soldier from a drone platoon poses during a military exercise, the first of its kind since an update to the country’s military service policy.
Birmingham, UK A delegate in a chainmail suit attends the second day of the annual Reform UK party conference at the NEC.
Beijing, China Models display creations from the XiaoZhuangTanYun collection by Midori during China fashion week.
Rasuwa, Nepal One of two workers is carried to safety after being pulled alive from a tunnel at the Trishuli-3A hydropower project nine days after deadly flash floods.
Devighat, Nuwakot, Nepal A man takes photographs on a devastated area near the Trishuli River after the deadly flash floods and a mudslide.
Hagonoy, Philippines A bride walks the aisle of St John the Baptist Parish as a wedding continues despite flood waters filling the church.

caption: Brovary, Ukraine Firefighters work at the site of a warehouse hit by a Russian drone strike.
Kyiv, Ukraine Residents wait outside a damaged building after a Russian strike on the capital.
Fayzabad, Afghanistan Niqab-clad women holding their children sit at a gas station in the Badakhshan province.
Svay Chek, Cambodia A ‘waiting village’ constructed by the government of more than 3,000 houses. The village is the temporary home for people who fled last year’s border conflict with Thailand.
Berlin, Germany A pair of robot dogs attend the opening of the 2026 IFA international trade show for consumer electronics and home appliances.
Manila, Philippines A dog named Hartly takes part in a ‘dog pawshion show’.
Nair Schinca and Nicolás Schell dance while fellow competitors watch on.
Edinburgh, Scotland Protesters against datacentres attend a rally at the Scottish parliament. Fourteen campaign groups have joined together to fight the AI-led projects in Scotland.
Jiangsu, China Farmers feed geese on a mudflat at Sanhe, near the city of Huai’an.
London, England France’s president, Emmanuel Macron, and his wife, Brigitte, arrive at Downing Street for a meeting with the UK’s prime minister, Andy Burnham, and his wife, Marie-France van Heel.
Timure Bazar, Nepal Two buses and other vehicles lie stranded amid debris after the deadly flash floods and mudslides in Rasuwa.
Toronto, Canada A motorist stands in the open roof of a car that became stranded on the Don Valley Parkway during a storm that left thousands of people without power.
Madrid, Spain Protesters gather in support of the enclave of Ceuta and against the Spanish government’s handling of the migration crisis.
Singapore A crow perches on a tree branch, silhouetted against the sun rising over the island city-state.

Durban, South Africa South African Police Service (SAPS) officers stop a member of March and March Movement from clashing with foreign nationals during a demonstration against undocumented migrants. A demonstration against undocumented migrants in South Africa descended into violence with one foreign national arrested and a community leader saying five Congolese were hurt.
Buenos Aires, Argentina Nair Schinca prepares her shoes before competing in the stage category at the tango world championships. More than 800 couples entered from 47 countries.

Khan Younis, Gaza Hashem Abu Mustafa, who suffers from muscular dystrophy and severe malnutrition, lies on a bed. The two-year-old has high fevers and frequent seizures amid the severe food and medicine crisis caused by an Israeli blockade.
Beijing, China Models present creations by the menswear brand Vicutu at the opening show of the autumn edition of China fashion week.

Ceuta, Spain A makeshift camp holding some of the 5,000 to 10,000 migrants who remain in Ceuta after crossing the border from Morocco. Around 72,000 people made it into the Spanish enclave at the end of July, with the majority being returned within days.
Kyiv, Ukraine A plume of smoke rises from the site of a Russian drone strike on the outskirts of the capital.
Erzurum, Turkey Haci Kirmac, who is known as the Handlebar Moustache of Horasan, poses in his barbershop. Maintaining a family tradition, he once grew his moustache to a length of 150cm (5ft).
Pati, Indonesia Dead fish lie on a riverbed at the Karet Sungai Juana dam during the dry season in Central Java province.
Kyiv, Ukraine A Ukrainian air defence unit hits a Russian jet-powered drone launched at the capital.
